milt.definition:
n. fish sperm or sperm-filled reproductive gland; having a creamy texture
n. seminal fluid produced by male fish
milt.translation:
n. 脾脏, 鱼白, 精液
vt. 使受精

miltiades.translation: (miltiade 的复数) n. (Miltiade)人名；(罗)米尔蒂亚德

milton.definition: n. English poet; remembered primarily as the author of an epic poem describing humanity's fall from grace (1608-1674)
milton.translation: n. 米尔顿（男子名, 英国诗人）

milton keynes.translation: n. 米尔顿凯恩斯（地名）；牛仔裤

milton snavely hershey.translation: [网络] 斯内夫利·赫尔希；贺喜；弥尔顿·斯内夫利·赫尔希

milton's disease.translation: [医] 密尔顿氏病, 巨大荨麻疹, 血管神经性水肿

milton's edema.translation: [医] 密尔顿氏水肿, 血管神经性水肿

miltonia.translation: [网络] 堇花兰；堇花兰属；密尔顿兰属

miltonian.translation: a. 弥尔顿（英国诗人, 政论家, 1608-1674）的或其作品的, 似弥尔顿的作品的

miltonic.definition:
a. Of, pertaining to, or resembling, Milton, or his
   writings; as, Miltonic prose.
miltonic.translation: a. 弥尔顿的, 弥尔顿风格的, 庄严的

miltons.definition: n English poet; remembered primarily as the author of an epic poem describing humanity's fall from grace (1608-1674)

miltown.definition: n a sedative and tranquilizer (trade name Miltown and Equanil and Meprin) used to treat muscle tension and anxiety
miltown.translation: n. 安宁,眠尔通(安眠药)[商标名]
